process_name: Opening a Personal Deposit Account in Bangladesh
steps: Choose a bank and deposit-account type
Check whether the bank supports branch opening, electronic onboarding, or both
Complete the application and provide the identity information requested by the bank
For e-KYC, complete National ID and biometric identity verification
Provide any bank-specific customer-due-diligence information
Fund the account if the selected product requires an opening deposit
Activate the available card and digital-banking tools
typical_requirements: National ID and biometric verification for e-KYC
Opening deposit if required by the product
notes: Bangladesh Bank's e-KYC guidance covers electronic onboarding of natural persons and bases electronic identity verification on National ID and biometric data. Branch processes and additional due-diligence requests vary by institution.

sources.title: Bangladesh Bank Guidelines on Electronic Know Your Customer

process_name: Opening a Personal Deposit Account in India
steps: Choose a bank and account type
Complete an application through a supported branch or digital channel
Provide one officially valid identity/address document or authorize retrieval of valid KYC data
Provide PAN or Form 60, as applicable
Provide a recent photograph and any additional information required under the bank's KYC policy
Complete in-person, Aadhaar-enabled, CKYC, or video verification when offered and applicable
Fund and activate the account under the selected product's terms
typical_requirements: One officially valid document, such as passport, driving licence, Aadhaar proof, voter ID, NREGA job card, or NPR letter
notes: RBI guidance permits multiple KYC paths and identifies several officially valid documents; Aadhaar is not the only possible identity document. Exact channel availability is bank-specific.

sources.title: RBI Master Direction — Know Your Customer

process_name: Opening a Personal Deposit Account in the Philippines
steps: Choose a bank and account type
Check whether the product can be opened online or requires a branch visit
Complete the application and provide a valid identification document
Complete the bank's identity check, which may include a selfie or video interview online
Provide customer and contact information required by the bank
Fund the account within the bank's deadline if an initial deposit is required
Activate the available card and online-banking access
typical_requirements: Selfie or video identity check for some online applications
Personal mobile number and contact details
Initial deposit if required by the product
notes: BSP basic deposit accounts use simplified onboarding and no maintaining balance, while regular accounts may have different requirements. BDO's published flow illustrates online and branch paths; other banks can differ.

sources.title: BSP Manual of Regulations for Banks — Basic Deposit Account

process_name: Opening a Bank Account in the United States
steps: Compare banks or credit unions, account features, fees, and deposit-insurance status
Gather a tax identification number and acceptable identity document
Complete an application in person, online, or in a mobile app when offered
Make the first deposit if the account requires one
Sign the required documents electronically or in person
Activate online or mobile banking and any debit or ATM card
typical_requirements: Social Security number or Individual Taxpayer Identification Number when requested
Acceptable identity document, such as a driver's license, state or military ID, or passport
notes: Citizenship is not universally required. FDIC notes that some banks accept alternatives such as a foreign passport, consular ID, or ITIN; acceptance is institution-specific.
